title: 1611 Sanriku earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1611 Sanriku earthquake", at revision 1366163337, opens: "The 1611 Sanriku earthquake  occurred on December 2, 1611, with an epicenter off the Sanriku coast in Iwate Prefecture, Japan. The magnitude of the earthquake was 8.1Ms. It triggered a devastating tsunami. A description of this event in an official diary from 1612 is probably the first recorded use of the term 'tsunami'." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3388870, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Earthquake and tsunami affecting Japan". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
